parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no <props="intl"><ph>**Overview** page or </ph></props>instance ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The ProductKey of the product. The ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for a new product. You can view the information about all products under the current account in the IoT Platform console or by calling [QueryProductList](~~69271~~).

sub_parameters.name: TagKey
sub_parameters.description:
The tag key of the product tag. The key can be up to 30 characters in length and can contain uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, and periods (.).

> The TagKey that you specify must be an existing tag key. The TagKey values cannot be duplicate.

sub_parameters.name: TagValue
sub_parameters.description: The updated tag value. The value can be up to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). A Chinese character counts as two characters.
